question: Which is the First country to introduce the idea of prioritizing happiness over economic growth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhutan**__.

**__Key Points__**

• **Bhutan** is the first and only country in the world to officially prioritize **Gross National Happiness (GNH)** over **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** as a measure of national progress.

• The concept of **Gross National Happiness** was coined by the **Fourth King of Bhutan, Jigme Singye Wangchuck**, in **1972**. He famously declared that **'Gross National Happiness is more important than Gross Domestic Product'**.

• The philosophy of **GNH** is based on the premise that true development of a society takes place when material and spiritual development occur side by side to complement and reinforce each other.

• The **GNH** framework is anchored by **four pillars**: **Sustainable and Equitable Socio-Economic Development**, **Environmental Conservation**, **Preservation and Promotion of Culture**, and **Good Governance**.
